name: create-task
businessNeed: Capture a categorized commitment quickly and consistently, whether it originates from a person or an accepted AI suggestion.

workItems.description: Define validated create-task input using TaskCategory and TaskPriority enums.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: Invalid category, priority, or blank title returns a typed failure.

workItems.description: Implement and test the AIFA feature using only declared capabilities.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: A task is persisted as Todo and audited.

workItems.description: Register the MUI composer slot contribution.
workItems.acceptanceCriterion: A submitted form refreshes the typed task model.
